findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: persona_list_cases, persona_get_case · Private data: persona_list_accounts, persona_get_account, persona_get_verification, persona_list_transactions, persona_get_transaction · Public sink: persona_add_account_tag.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: persona_list_cases, persona_get_case · Private data: persona_list_accounts, persona_get_account, persona_get_verification, persona_list_transactions, persona_get_transaction · Public sink: persona_add_account_tag

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
